question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

In your birthday suit

options.text: A suit which covers one’s entire body
A suit which is designed for only birthday functions

solution:
The correct answer is **'Not wearing any clothes'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'In your birthday suit'** is** 'Not wearing any clothes'.**
 
• If you are in your birthday suit, you are not wearing any clothes.
 
• **In your birthday suit:** not wearing any clothes. (कोई कपड़े नहीं पहने हुए)
 
 
• *Example: They were sunbathing **in their birthday suits.***

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Not wearing any clothes.*
